review.why: Build a marketing performance report: key metrics, trends, wins and misses, and prioritized recommendations for a campaign, channel or period.
review.summary: Picks the report type, gathers metrics from connected analytics or pasted data, and builds an eight-part report. References give metric definitions and benchmark ranges per channel, weekly, monthly and quarterly templates, dashboard principles, trend and forecasting basics, attribution models and an optimization process.
strengths: Metric definitions with formulas and what each one tells you, across email, social, paid, SEO and content.
Honest about limits: forecasts as ranges, low confidence under twelve data points, no attribution model is perfect.
Recommendations are ranked by impact and effort, with next-period priorities.
cautions: Written as a command with optional connectors marked by ~~ placeholders, and it points to a CONNECTORS.md outside the skill folder.
Benchmark ranges such as open and delivery rates are general and vary by industry.
The repository's LICENSE file is the Apache-2.0 text followed by unrelated stray text, so the license shows as unclear although GitHub detects Apache-2.0. Read in full but not run here.
